 To: The Directors 
 Waiver of pre-emption rights 
 I , Saad Idrees am the holder of 300,000 ordinary shares of PKR 10 each in the capital of the Company. 
 I refer to the proposed allotment of shares in the Company to Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited (the “ Proposed Allotment ” ) in accordance with a US$250,000 convertible loan facility agreement to be entered into on or around the date of this letter between the Company and Online Classifieds Pakistan (SMC-Private) Limited. 
 I , being shareholder of the Company and being entitled to certain pre-emption rights in respect of the shares to be issued by the Company pursuant to the Proposed Allotment, hereby confirm that I waive all such pre-emption rights (however arising) as I may have in relation to the Proposed Allotment. 
 I execute this waiver as a deed on the date stated above .
